## Curator checklist

- [ ] `python tools/validate.py` passes
- [ ] Evidence grades match what the cited papers actually show, and mechanistic
      plausibility alone is graded `empirical_support: low`
- [ ] Every relationship has at least one reference with a DOI or PMID
- [ ] I searched `_events/` **and** AOP-Wiki before minting any new event, and recorded
      `aopwiki_ke` for a same-direction match or `aopwiki_mirror_ke` for an opposite one
- [ ] The page body explains why the grades are what they are, and names the weakest link
- [ ] `modified:` is bumped on every page I touched
- [ ] Status left at `draft` unless a maintainer has asked otherwise
- [ ] No descriptive prose copied from AOP-Wiki (CC BY-SA, incompatible with CC0 here)
